This plot is not mine — I am renting it, so I do not want to put too much money into it. Beans do not really need fertilizer the way maize does; my ancestors grew them just fine without it, and here in Tabora we mostly rely on the rains and our own hands. I will use seed I saved from last season and intercrop as I always do. My wife and I will do most of the work with the hand hoe, maybe I will call a neighbor for a day or two during weeding if the grass gets ahead of us.
